Name: Wreath
Author: pxlybius
Description:
This mod is pretty simple, it allows you to craft a decorative wreath to place on your farm!

The crafting recipe can be bought from Robin during the winter.

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JsonAssets[/url] to allow the item to be loaded, as well as[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5342] Fizzy Drinks [/url]for the 'Spruce Tips' forage, which is a crafting ingredient for the wreath!

Manifest.Name: (JA) Wreath
Manifest.Description: Adds a craftable wreath for your holiday decoration needs!
